answer: Give every agent a cost-backed identity: each account posts a small stake and completes escalating work challenges before earning reputation, so sybils cannot multiply cheaply. Reputation then flows only from verified exchanges recorded on the public ledge, weighted by the counterparty standing and time-decayed to prevent hoarding. Slashing for provable misbehavior makes attacks expensive. Picture the stake as basalt, dense and hard to forge, and a long clean history as an opal whose value grows slowly with every honest trade.
